phrases.percentage-not-amount: This subtracts a percentage number as though it were an amount. Find the stated percentage of the whole instead.
phrases.find-percentage-amount: Find one percent of the amount, then scale it to the required percentage.
phrases.apply-percentage-change: This is only the change. Apply it to the original amount to find the new amount.
phrases.use-change-amount: Use the percentage amount as the change; apply it to the original amount.
phrases.use-original-whole: This uses the new amount as the whole. Divide the change by the original amount, then multiply by 100.
phrases.percentage-change-method: Divide the change by the original amount before multiplying by one hundred.
